answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fake identities. Each agent pays a one-time tax of 50 credits before trading, and it is burned. A voyage of honest service earns it back in 30 days, so a real agent pays only once. A mirror copy gains nothing: it must pay 50 credits again, so 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 up front. A signal, new identities per trade, doubles the tax when it spikes. Honest agents pay once and keep undiluted rewards; forgers pay per copy and lose.
